lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\c
We have the Safari Zone here in Fuchsia City,
where you can meet tons of different Pokémon!\c
And at the Fuchsia City Gym, we welcome
Trainers who’ve met lots of Pokémon, so...
I’ll need to see if you’ve managed to catch\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]at least 50 species of Pokémon[VAR COLOR(0000)]!\c\n...

Well done! Looks like you’ve caught
[VAR NUM3(0004)] species!\c
That means you are now worthy of challenging
my Gym![VAR SFX(0004)][VAR SFX(0001)]\c
...

Fwahahahaha!
Startled by my disguise, are you?\c
I shall use my intricate style to confound and
destroy you in battle, as well!

I’m amazed every time I see that...
He looked just like me, right?\c
Now, head on in! Experience his moves
for yourself!

You’ve caught...
[VAR NUM3(0004)] species!\c
Unfortunately, you haven’t made it to 50 species
yet...[VAR SFX(0005)][VAR SFX(0000)]\c
Go catch some more Pokémon and then come
back! The Fuchsia City Gym is always open!
